en.help.doc.open: Open an existing design or import a supported CAD, mesh or point-cloud file into a new design. Use this to start working from a saved file.
en.help.file.export_3mf: Export placed bodies as a 3MF mesh file. Use it for additive manufacturing workflows that support named objects.
en.help.file.export_glb: Export the displayed bodies and their appearance as GLB. Use it to exchange a textured model with visualization tools.
en.help.file.export_json: Export a copy of the complete editable design as JSON. This does not change the current design's save path.
en.help.file.export_nx_assembly: Export the complete assembly as STEP with named components and their placements. Open it in NX with assembly structure enabled to create component parts. This writes a .step exchange file, not a native NX .prt file.
en.help.file.export_obj: Export placed meshes with their colours and supported texture images. Keep the OBJ, MTL and image files together when transferring a textured scan.
en.help.file.export_parasolid: Export the placed CAD bodies as a Parasolid text file. Unsupported geometry is reported before replacing a file.
en.help.file.export_step: Export exact CAD geometry as STEP, preserving assembly structure when exporting the entire design. Use it for editable CAD exchange.
en.help.file.export_stl: Export bodies as a triangulated STL file. Use it for printing workflows that do not need colours or component structure.
en.help.file.export_urdf: Export the assembly as a URDF robot with associated mesh files. Use it to transfer links and joints to robotics tools.
en.help.file.export_view_dxf: Export the current view as a DXF drawing. Use it to transfer projected outlines to a drafting application.
